caption: Some nights I need dinner on the table FAST, but I still want to keep introducing my toddler to new flavors and cuisines. 🙌 I grabbed the @myserenitykids Chicken Tikka Masala pouch from @sprouts and turned it into the easiest weeknight meal. I mixed it with cooked chicken, mushrooms, onions, and rice, then served it in her @omielifeinc plate. I’ll admit, she was a little hesitant at first 😅 but after a few bites, she was hooked and ended up loving it! What I love about this pouch is that you get those warm, flavorful tikka masala spices without the heat, making it perfect for little taste buds. Such an easy way to switch things up from our usual dinner rotation while helping her become a more adventurous eater.
